claims.claim: The project documents K1G control/auth over UDP 2000/2002, RSA session setup, 526x300 H.264 projection and RTP over UDP 5000 with FU-A packetization.
claims.notes: The reviewed client binds its control socket to local UDP 2000 and its receiver to local UDP 2002. It does not validate the remote source port. Specific packet and firmware compatibility remains unverified.
